summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of P.A.L.M.E Leave Policy implementation. All 9 backend pytest cases pass (100%). Frontend UI verified: P.A.L.M.E branding, 5 admin tabs (My Requests, Pending Approval, Monthly Summary, All Employees, Rewards & Penalties), year selector, September accrual banner for 2026, correct reward amounts (₹200/₹500/₹2,000) and penalty (₹100).
critical_code_review_comments: leave_management.py is 1400+ lines - consider splitting into leave_requests, palme_policy, wfh, rewards modules for maintainability
In get_leave_balance() line 190-193, both if/else branches compute same expression (remaining_months = 12 - accrual_start_month + 1) - branch is redundant
SPECIAL_YEAR_ACCRUAL_START hardcoded for 2026 only. Should be configurable via DB or env for future years
get_leave_balance() runs 4+ sequential Mongo queries per user; all-employees endpoint loops this for every user causing N+1 queries - consider single aggregation pipeline for scalability
add_reward/add_penalty use Form(...) instead of JSON body - inconsistent with rest of API (which uses Pydantic models)
medical_certificate_data stored as base64 directly in Mongo document - should use object storage for large files
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend clock is currently 2026-09-02 which explains accrued=2 days for 2026 (Sep=month 9, (9-9+1)*2=2). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_palme_leave.py covers balance year 2025/2026, policy amounts, monthly-summary, all-employees, and auth guards. Frontend route is /admin/leave (not /admin/leave-management).
